correctness.rationale: For each odd polynomial f=t h, testing the even compression Bf against h gives the strictly positive integral of |t||h|^2 and proves odd-block injectivity. Reflection makes the centered operator anti-diagonal, determining exact central multiplicity and paired eigenvalues. On the uniform unit ball the beta-moment projection of |t| and the transverse t*y_j moments give two orthogonal singular sectors with exact s0,s1 formulas, their strict order and normalized extremizers. The included standalone checker independently assembles monomial Gram matrices and passes 24 dimension-band tests. No infinite statement rests on numerical enumeration.

value.rationale: Exact polynomial-bandwidth energy concentration is a natural invariant in Slepian analysis. The result gives an all-degree rigid midpoint multiplicity for any positive symmetric weight, full explicit degree-two spectra for every ball dimension, a unique exact top-concentration polynomial, and nontrivial high-dimensional constants 3/pi and 2/pi. These furnish meaningful exact finite-band benchmarks beyond existing asymptotic eigenvalue counts.
